objective: Test whether a fixed target-independent RBF random-feature sketch followed by regularized SAVE yields one continuous OI geometry that retains SAVE's linear and quadratic ranking while recovering periodic and local target dependence.

ancestry.development_status: follow-up on previously observed synthetic panels; all claims remain exploratory

random_fourier_geometry.input: one row-L2 normalization of observed embeddings
random_fourier_geometry.bandwidth_sample: at most 256 deterministic evenly spaced training-fold rows
random_fourier_geometry.bandwidth: gamma = 1 / (2 * median positive pairwise squared distance)
random_fourier_geometry.features: sqrt(2 / m) * cos(XW + b), W_ij sampled N(0, 2*gamma), b_j sampled Uniform(0, 2*pi), followed by row-L2 normalization
random_fourier_geometry.randomness: fixed from the existing fold seed
random_fourier_geometry.leakage: bandwidth and random map are constructed within each cross-fit training fold; holdout rows are transform-only

rff_save_geometry.save: the exact regularized rank-8 pooled-residual SAVE transform from continuous_save_ranking
rff_save_geometry.leakage: target cells, residual correction, whitening, conditional covariance, and projection are all fitted inside each training fold

reference_heads.envelope: maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen heads on observed features

reference_performance_gate.interpretation: Aggregate claims require every per-panel performance floor and both nonlinear-head win counts to pass.

success_gate.overall_requirement: A dimension passes only if its overall Spearman is at least SAVE, mean regret is no more than 0.02 worse, every listed first/second-moment family loses at most 0.10 Spearman, sinusoid gains at least 0.20, and triangle wave gains at least 0.15. Either fixed dimension may pass; results are not used to tune a dimension.

axis_metrics.quality_at_fixed_nuisance: Primary monotonic ranking estimand within each nuisance level.
axis_metrics.nuisance_at_fixed_quality: Secondary sensitivity estimand within each quality level.

primary_contrasts: RFF without SAVE versus observed OI
both RFF-SAVE dimensions versus residual-only and the privileged quadratic-lift ceiling
primary_metrics: panel and fixed-nuisance quality Spearman with the best-head envelope
negative actual-loss and negative loss-ratio Spearman
tie_rule: Average envelope performance across candidates tied at absolute tolerance 1e-12 for the maximum selector score.
scope: Exploratory synthetic development evidence on previously observed panel families; no production, confirmation, or generalization claim.
